description: Source code for CKEditor plugin 'menu', defining menu and submenu classes, menu items, and configuration, used for creating and managing context menus within CKEditor.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.menu
classes.description: Class representing a menu, capable of showing/hiding, adding items, and handling submenus.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.menuItem
classes.description: Class representing a menu item, with rendering logic and state management.

methods.name: beforeInit
methods.description: Initialization function called before the plugin is fully initialized, setting up menu groups and items.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a menu item to the menu.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all menu items from the menu.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the menu at a specified position.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the menu item as HTML.
